 Wife says husband can’t get GTA 6 after waiting forever because ‘you’re gonna have to have a girlfriend in the game and that’s cheating’
 The Mary Sue Follow Kelsey Knowles Fri, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Fri, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 PM UTC Image by itsme_mcmuffin on TikTok and ™/®Rockstar Games, Public domain. Via Wikimedia Commons. A TikTok creator says his wife won't let him play GTA 6 because having a girlfriend in the game would count as cheating, according to the Daily Dot . The creator, @ itsme_mcmuffin , posted the exchange days before the game's release. It's unclear whether the argument is genuine or a skit, as the outlet said it could not independently verify the events.
 The video opens with the creator asking his wife, "So what you're saying is that you're not gonna let me get GTA 6. Why?" She replies, "Because it's cheating." She follows up with her reasoning: "Cause you're gonna have to have a girlfriend in the game and that's cheating," then adds, "Next question."
 When he insists, "I'm gonna play the game," his wife tells him, "You're playing it single." He responds, "Apparently you can't play it single because you have to have a girlfriend, right?" and the clip ends there. GTA 6 launched days after the video was posted, with Rockstar on track to make billions from the release.
 He tried every argument, and she still wasn't budging 
 The creator points out that the gaming community has been holding out for this release for a long time. "We've collectively waited for GTA 6 forever," he says. His wife appears unmoved by the wider excitement, replying, "I don't care about the world. I care about you."
 Advertisement Advertisement He continues his case. "Everything has tried to keep this game from coming out forever and it's almost here, and you're telling me now you're not gonna let me play this game," he says. However, his wife holds firm, telling him, "You're not gonna get to play this game," and adding that she doesn't care if he's upset.
 That in-game girlfriend is a lot more optional than it sounds 
 GTA 6 follows two playable protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a criminal couple whose relationship sits at the center of the story. That likely makes Lucia the girlfriend in question, though she's Jason's partner rather than a romance the player has to pursue. Players can also take control of Lucia herself.
 Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told IGN that players who aren't interested in the romance can skip it, per TechRadar . However, he said the pair will remain partners in crime whether they're romantically close or not. The relationship can cool off, but Lucia isn't leaving the story.
 The creator's complaint about waiting forever also holds up. GTA 6 arrived more than 13 years after GTA 5, following two delays that pushed it from 2025 to May 2026 and then to November 19. The game has since earned a 99 out of 100 on Metacritic from 150 critic reviews.
